claims.claim: Astera Labs identity is reproducibly tied to CIK 0001736297 and NASDAQ ticker ALAB in the current packet identity/tradability record.

The Q2 2026 operating evidence originates from SEC accession 0001736297-26-000035 (10-Q); the Astera investor-relations Q2 release is a same-origin company disclosure and is not counted as an independent corroborating origin.

The September 15 Leo product evidence and May 5 Scorpio product evidence are company-origin IR disclosures; they are valid primary product evidence but must not be inflated into multiple independent origins merely because they are separate URLs.

risks.risk: Issuer IR and SEC filing evidence are primary but not independent of the issuer; source-independence confidence must reflect origin collapse.

unknowns.unknown: No independent third-party source is required to establish filed financial facts, but independent corroboration for market/competitive assertions is not present in this Alpha object.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $392.4M, +27% sequentially and +104% year over year; six-month revenue was $700.761M versus $351.367M in the prior-year period.
At June 30, 2026 Astera held $111.453M cash plus $1.142B marketable securities, supporting strong near-term liquidity.
Accounts receivable rose to $192.469M and inventory to $113.781M from $83.202M and $58.979M respectively at 2025 year-end, creating a working-capital conversion watch item during the ramp.
Management expected Scorpio X-Series to become the largest product family in Q3 2026; this is a measurable catalyst/execution checkpoint, not realized Q3 evidence.
The September 15 Leo expansion broadens Astera into CXL/fabric-attached memory; sampling/design-win language does not establish production revenue or durable share.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Filed Q2 revenue +104% YoY and +27% sequentially with six-month revenue nearly doubling; working-capital expansion prevents a maximum assessment.

catalystScore.basis: Scorpio expected to become largest product family in Q3 and Leo sampling creates near-term measurable execution milestones, but realized conversion is not yet filed.

alignment2036.basis: Products directly address AI rack-scale connectivity and memory-capacity/utilization constraints.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Portfolio spans signal conditioning, fabric switching and memory connectivity, giving multiple attach paths across AI infrastructure.

bottleneckControl.basis: Scorpio and Leo target fabric bandwidth/latency and memory utilization bottlenecks; merchant substitutes and vertical integration cap control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Multi-protocol/platform breadth supports several AI infrastructure architectures, while hyperscaler/platform concentration and custom silicon reduce robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Open standards and broad portfolio provide resilience, but custom/vertically integrated fabrics are credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong liquidity supports execution, but current cited evidence does not establish diversified manufacturing/supplier resilience; conservative assessment preserves that uncertainty.

riskEvidence.basis: Strong liquidity and growth offset risks from working-capital expansion, customer/platform concentration, qualification/ramp execution and merchant-silicon substitution.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC filing plus current primary product disclosures support operating/catalyst facts; confidence is reduced for issuer-origin concentration and unsupported valuation/governance/pricing dimensions.

risks.risk: Receivables and inventory expanded sharply during the growth ramp; cash conversion remains to be demonstrated.
Custom silicon and vertical integration can substitute for merchant connectivity content.
Sampling/design wins for Leo do not establish production volume or revenue contribution.

contradictions.claim: Rapid revenue growth versus sharply higher receivables/inventory
contradictions.resolution: Both are supported by the same filed period; treat working-capital build as a risk/watch item rather than evidence that negates the realized growth.

unknowns.unknown: Q3 realized Scorpio mix and production conversion are not yet established by a filed quarter.
Current valuation opportunity is not supported by the cited evidence set.
GovernancePower lacks current proxy/10-K evidence in the cumulative packet.
PricingPower lacks sufficient filed margin/mix evidence for a defensible numeric component.
